data.title: RBSO celebrates birthday with bold, high-octane programme
data.description: <p>Under the Royal Patronage of HRH Princess Sirivannavari Nariratana Rajakanya, the Royal Bangkok Symphony Orchestra recently celebrated the birthday of HRH Chulabhorn Krom Phra Srisavangavadhana at the Thailand Cultural Centre, with a special dedicated concert titled "Royal Harmony".</p>

data.title: Remembering a departed mother
data.description: <p>Somtow Sucharitkul along with the Siam Sinfonietta and many celebrated musicians and artists performed a heartfelt tribute to Her Late Majesty Queen Sirikit the Queen Mother last month.</p>

data.title: Silent sacrifices
data.description: <p>According to the National Statistical Office, in 2024 there were 31 elderly people under the care of 100 working adults. This means approximately three working adults provided care for one elderly person.</p>

data.title: Dreams, drama and dread: 72 clubs begin the promotion battle
data.description: <p>Although the Premier League does not kick off until next week, the English football season really gets under way this weekend as the 72 clubs in the Championship, League One and League Two begin their new campaigns. We've already had the opening round of the Carabao League Cup, which, probably, served as a useful warm up for managers and players alike.</p>

data.title: Cova brings Milanese café heritage to Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok has been chosen as the latest destination for Cova, the historic Italian café and pâtisserie acquired by LVMH, as the more than 200-year-old Milanese maison continues expanding its legacy of craftsmanship, hospitality and luxury.

data.title: School safety bill in works
data.description: <p>The Education Ministry is preparing a school safety bill for cabinet approval as authorities tighten security following copycat threats of violence at several educational institutions.</p>

data.title: Lions stand in War Elephants' way
data.description: <p>Seven-time champions Thailand will take on Singapore in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-finals on Saturday night in a clash between two nations that boast a combined 11 regional titles in the tournament's 30-year history.</p>

data.title: Gun prizes for village leaders axed
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) to stop awarding firearms as prizes to village and subdistrict chiefs.</p>

data.title: Jobless claim 'recruitment scam' cost them B20m
data.description: <p>More than 80 job seekers have filed complaints with anti-human trafficking police, alleging a recruitment agency swindled them out of more than 20 million baht with false promises of jobs in Canada and Finland.</p>

data.title: Dems threaten EC over Senate case

data.title: Anutin sets out five priorities for RTAF
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined five policy priorities to strengthen the Royal Thai Air Force's (RTAF) operational capabilities and national security.</p>

data.title: Trump dismisses concerns over conditions on US aircraft carrier
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump dismissed concerns Friday over living conditions and the mental health of service members on a US aircraft carrier deployed against Iran and said the ship would soon rotate out.

data.title: Colombia hopes for miracles as search for quake victims goes on
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - The chances of finding earthquake survivors in Colombia dropped significantly on Friday, four days after the 7.4-magnitude tremor struck, though rescue efforts plowed ahead as hundreds remained missing.

data.title: Homeless, jobless: Colombia quake survivors 'left with nothing'
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Nine-year-old Sebastian paints a portrait of his family home, unable to comprehend that it no longer exists after the powerful quake that shattered western Colombia this week.

data.title: Premier League club Liverpool sell minority stake to Jeff Bezos consortium
data.description: LONDON - Liverpool's owners have agreed to sell a minority stake in the Premier League club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil Anane launches Thailand Olympic boxing bid – but must earn LA28 spot
data.description: ONE Championship will support Nabil Anane’s attempt to earn a place in Thailand’s boxing team for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics – but the promotion’s former bantamweight Muay Thai champion will not be fast-tracked into the national squad.

data.title: Italian police recover stolen paintings worth €9 million
data.description: ROME - Paintings by Renoir, Cezanne and Matisse worth over nine million euros which were stolen from a museum in Italy in March have been recovered, Italian police said on Friday.

data.title: Khon Kaen temple land battle heats up
data.description: The abbot of a forest temple in Khon Kaen has produced the original title deed for land donated more than three decades ago, as the donor’s heirs intensify their efforts to reclaim the site.

data.title: Garage owner linked to MP’s shooting sentenced
data.description: NARATHIWAT - A court in this southern province has sentenced a garage owner to five years in prison for dismantling an Internal Security Operations Command (Isoc) pickup truck used in the shooting of a Prachachat Party MP.

data.title: Zambia suspends vote counting, citing violence
data.description: LUSAKA - Zambia suspended vote counting nationwide on Friday following reports of violence in some districts, the electoral commission said.

data.title: AWC Unveils THB 50bn REIT Plan for 2026 Listing
data.description: Asset World Corp plans to list a THB 50bn freehold REIT on the Thai bourse within 2026, seeding it with five projects from its 61-strong portfolio

data.title: French family rescued after night adrift off Samui
data.description: SURAT THANI: Three French tourists — a father and his two young sons — have been rescued after drifting overnight in the sea off Koh Samui when their rented jet ski became stranded in rough conditions.

data.title: Europe battles wildfires: latest developments
data.description: PARIS - Countries across Europe were battling a wave of new wildfires Friday as blistering temperatures and tinder-dry landscapes made for dangerous conditions.

data.title: NATO jets shoot down drone in Latvian airspace
data.description: RIGA - NATO said on Friday that its fighter jets shot down a drone that entered Latvian airspace, the latest incursion along the military alliance’s eastern flank bordering Russia.

data.title: Emirati tourists arrested after fleeing checkpoint, injuring policeman
data.description: PHUKET: Two Emirati tourists were arrested after allegedly fleeing a police checkpoint in Kathu district, kicking a pursuing officer’s motorcycle and causing him to crash during a chase, police said on Friday.

data.title: Exiled Putin critic says push for peace put him in danger

data.title: Is a new conflict brewing in northern Ethiopia?
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - A recent flare-up in tensions in Ethiopia’s Tigray, including reports of heavy artillery battles and drone strikes, has raised fears of a return to war in the northern state — a conflict potentially stoked by foreign nations.

data.title: Farage wins UK by-election as Count Binface claims 'moral victory'
data.description: CLACTON-ON-SEA (UNITED KINGDOM) - Hard-right British politician Nigel Farage was re-elected to his parliamentary seat Friday in a by-election shunned by the major parties -- handing his main rival, joke candidate Count Binface, a larger than expected share of the vote.

data.title: School in Loei suspends classes after student allegedly threatens shooting
data.description: Loei Pittayakom School in Loei province suspended on-site classes on Friday after discovering online chat messages in which a Matthayom Suksa 2 (Grade 8) student allegedly told a friend that he was planning to carry out a shooting at the school, reportedly inspired by the Aug 7 attack near Bangkok.

data.title: China's viral 'spicy strips' take a bite of global snack market
data.description: PINGJIANG (CHINA) - At a gleaming new factory in China's central hinterland, masked workers in white uniform season and sift through mounds of latiao, a longtime popular snack that has found hungry fans overseas.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kana wants Vero rematch, says ‘rounds one and three were mine’
data.description: Kana wants another shot at Vero Nika in ONE Championship after claiming she won two of the three rounds in their contentious atomweight kickboxing fight.

data.title: Did Aristotle exist? China targets pseudo-history myths claiming West stole civilisations

data.title: Department of Local Administration opens score review for local govt candidates
